cards.headline: A 42% bill increase should not become a second job.
cards.subhead: Investigate quietly. Interrupt only when there is something worth deciding.
cards.visual: A small bill line rises 42%; beneath it, rate, weather, and household causes remain unresolved.

cards.headline: The model proposes. Deterministic gates decide what counts.
cards.subhead: Watcher → Strands Swarm + AgentSkills → evidence/readiness → GoalLoop + guards → human approval
cards.visual: Five-stage horizontal architecture. Place Runtime Inspector as an audit rail beneath every stage. Label execution target 'local Strands' unless AgentCore is truly deployed.

cards.headline: Most agents are optimized to finish.
cards.subhead: Sift is optimized to know when it has not earned the right to answer.
